reason: I'm 65 and my phone already rings from Google Maps when people search 'taxi Omiš' or 'rafting Cetina'. I've never had a website and the guests still find me, so why pay €600 now?
objection: My Facebook page and Google Maps already bring me guests, and they already WhatsApp me directly. A website is one more thing to pay for every month and I don't see it bringing new bookings I don't already get.
would_change_my_mind: If a colleague on the coast showed me in real numbers that a website brought him more bookings, or if you fix my Google Maps first and I see the calls go up before paying for the site.
